configurePresets.name: host-standalone
configurePresets.displayName: Host tests (ASan+UBSan, build dir next to the checkout)
configurePresets.description: Configures this project from a plain checkout: no environment variables, no local tooling. Gate tests that need the maintainers' own scripts are left out (KISAK_LOCAL_GATES).

configurePresets.name: host
configurePresets.description: Configures tests/ (the standalone host-test CMake project) into the per-worktree state dir ./test already resolves via KISAK_TEST_STATE_DIR, so concurrent worktrees never share build objects.

configurePresets.name: host-tsan
configurePresets.description: Same project, a separate binary dir, for the handful of tests registered twice (once under ASan+UBSan, once under TSan) -- see core-thread-tsan in tests/host/core_group.cmake. Most TSan tests build fine alongside the ASan ones in one tree since each target picks its own sanitizer flags; this preset exists for a from-scratch TSan-only rebuild.
